scientific_integrity: The theorem is justified by an all-base marker-gap proof; direct finite verifications are supportive, not an infinite certificate. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This theorem covers only the shortest-new-contiguous-factor Ziv–Lempel parsing for the radix-power marker word; no Crochemore or LZ77 claim and no unrestricted automatic-word theorem. An unindexed equivalent is possible; the 2007 broad-growth paper was not available in full.
title: Exact Ziv–Lempel parsing of radix-power marker words
